[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of both the Seventh Amendment to Concession Agreement LAA-8562 and the Ninth Amendment to Ground Lease LAA-8562-1 with Authorized Taxicab Supervision Inc.: To extend their respective terms for up to twelve (12) months, covering taxicab staging and management at 9301 South Jetway Boulevard near Los Angeles International Airport; and modification to the Airport Taxicab Rate for the duration of the amendment (David Reich)
